objections.about: The customer asked a yes/no question about their 5,000 Blotato Creator credits. The reply only says provider and Blotato credits are separate and never says whether Seedance animation uses Blotato credits.

The customer calls the skill 'free'. The section describes animation as paid: it quotes estimated credits before spending and runs through kie.ai, with a balance check on kie.ai credits. The reply never says the animation is charged in kie.ai provider credits, so the 'free' premise goes uncorrected.
